newsitem.title: UK: ScottishPower to axe 500 at Southern -paper.
newsitem.headline: ScottishPower to axe 500 at Southern -paper.

text.p: ScottishPower, which reports results on December 4, is expected to announce this week the loss of over 500 jobs at Southern Water, the company it bought earlier this year for 1.68 billion stg, a newspaper reprt said.

The Sunday Times said cuts made in the core water business and from the disposal of Southern's 30 subsidiary companies could realise 40 million stg a year. Up to 700 workers could be axed out of a workforce of 3,900, but ScottishPower has promised there will be no compulsory redundancies, the paper said. ScottishPower will reveal its results next week after a delay which it said would give investors a better idea of how its takeover of Southern has fared.
Analysts are expecting a rise in first half profits.

Pre-tax profits before exceptionals are likely to be between 175 million stg and 189.4 million stg up from 127 million stg a year ago and a dividend is expected at around six pence a share from 5.17 pence last year.
